content: Yaubada koononōkobe nakae kokisoobuyēmi Tauyana yaina
Kaga unana vabobolagu be aumakimaki siisowóduwo yaimi? Unana ame: Toinimi imi vikaiya sivaayaviya imi nuwonúwana dedevina taiyao ae?

Imi yalagau pasina komatakónana go, geya itoboinemita kokabi, tauna kokaumata. Aiyuwoina kovakipikipi go, geya itoboinemita kónana kokabidi, tauna kokaumakimaki be kovaboobolagu. Go dogoiyadi geya kokabidita unana Yaubada yaina geya kokawanoita.
Nakona kokaawanoi go, ana katumapu geya kobabaneyeta unana imi nuwonúwana viviiyuwoidi. Bego dogoiyadi toinimi imi vikaiya manuna. Tauna imi kawanoi goi ami katumapu geya kobabaneyeta.

Komi toroerata nakae! Yaubada monemi nakae go, poyapoya sinapuna kooyaledi. Manakae? Geya koyagoiyeta avatauwa neta poyapoya sinapuna siuyaaonedi, e Yaubada sivaakaleye? Tauna avatauwa neta poyapoya sinapuna siuyaaonedi tauyadi Yaubada ana kaleyayao.

Seki nakona konuwonúwana bego Gínina Kimaasabaina ina talavaita moe talavaita geya basabasainamo ae? Talavaitayana kana, ‘Yaubada Balomaina boi iyato sinaeda mana vakókala latuwona toina kita anetava Tauyana manuna!’
Go Yaubada ikanuwoiyeda gagaina. Tauna Gínina Kimaasabaina goi italavaita idigo kana,
‘Tauyadi nuwaatuedi Yaubada ivakaaleyedi go, toosobudi ikanuwooiyedi.’ Nanamsa 3:34
Tauna Yaubada yaina kokatetaagonēmi go, Totagíwaya yaina koovadōkana, e yaimi goi bei isiya.
Yaubada koononōko bei Tauyana iiwokoimi. Komi toogoyoimi nimami konikīdi go, komi tonanayuwo nuwomi kokimasabēdi Yaubada umana.
Imi sinapu goyo pasidi mami nuwomou be mami kategeda kotaiyakuwokūwala. Goyoyadi pasidi taabu koovanāma nakae taabu koouyāwana, go sem mami nuwomou pasidi kotāiya.
Yauwe matana goi toinimi kokisoobuyēmi, e Tauyana bei ikilagasimi.

Taabu semiyao kokaogooyoēdi, segowo. Avatauwa komi neta semiyao kokaogooyoedi o kotaakinoidi tauyadi bego toogoyoidi, e moe nakae Yeisu ina lovina matakoi manuna bogina kokaogoyoe be nakae kotakino bego lovinayana goyogoyoina. Neta komi imi guinuwa nakae, e Yeisu ina lovinayana geya koguinuweyeta geya, go sem komi bego koetotakínona.
Go lovina ana Tokaiguyau be nakae ana Totakínona tayamo toito ikaaiyaka. Tauyana itoboine kita tomota iyaveda be ikaumateda. Moe Tauyana Yaubada. Tauna komi avatauwa bego semiyao kotakinoidi? Geya!
Taabu mami gágasakokaayomāna imi losinapu manudi
Komi tokaigimona konovēgu! Komi kokaayomana kami, ‘Ame o itomo kana asa tayamo goi bei tala tayamo kakaaiyaka. Amoko goi kapaaisewa, nakae kaagimona be kakaiigimona, e bei ima esaesa kababane.’
Moe nakae kobóbwara go, komi geya koyagoiyeta itomo kaga bei isowóduwo yawoimi goi. Kita tomota yawoida moe gaugau nakae. Gaugauyana isowóduwo, tuta kaakupina ikaaiyaka, e isawalamna.
Taabu nakae kokaayomāna, go sem kodīgo kami, ‘Neta ida Tomoya itagona, bei kakaaiyaka be nakae ame dogoiyadi latuwoma kaguuinuwedi.’
E ame tuta go mami gágasa kokaayomana go, ayomana madabokina amo nakae dogoi goyogoyoina.
Tauna avatau neta iyagoi ava guinuwa dedevidi itoboine iguinuwedi go, geya iguinuwedita, e moe ina goyo.
